headline: Salinas Valley News Briefs | Oct. 14, 2026
summary: Tire amnesty event offers free disposal SALINAS VALLEY — Salinas Valley residents can dispose of used car and small-truck tires for free through Nov. 8 at three Salinas Valley Solid Waste Authority facilities.
